newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.05 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.05 pct higher.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed slightly up despite lower turnover, a bourse official said.
The 31-share index closed at 492.97 points from 492.70 points on Tuesday.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing won 0.6 dinar to 33 dinars per share. Coke and beer bottler Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis gained 0.5 dinar to 86.
Retail stores Monoprix as up 0.48 dinar to 34.98 compared with Tuesday.
Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie rose 0.3 dinar to 47.5 dinars.
Banque de Tunisie edged up 0.3 dinar to 72.3.
Union Internationale de Banques bank gained 0.25 dinar to 13.5 dinars.
Total volume was 748,318 dinars against 5.8 million dinars over the previous session.
